title: Arachin daf 3

chapters.title: Parah Aduma and Aliyah
chapters.about: Parah Aduma, Hazaa, Aliyah, Eretz Yisrael

summary: Rabbi Soffer goes through the third page of Masekhet Arachin, examining the scope of various obligations and laws. He discusses who is included in the requirements for Zimun, Tumat Met, Tzara'at, the sprinkling of the ashes of the Parah Aduma, and the obligation to live in Eretz Yisrael. Additionally, he explores whether Kohanim are obligated in Sukkah, Tzitzit, Tefillin, and Tekiat Shofar, addressing potential exemptions based on their service in the Bet HaMikdash.
questions: Are children included in the obligation to make Zimun?
Can a Kohen who does not know the laws of Tzara'at declare someone Tameh?
Are Kohanim exempt from Sukkah because they are busy with the service in the Bet HaMikdash?
Why are Kohanim obligated to wear Tefillin shel Rosh even if they cannot wear Tefillin shel Yad during their service?
Are Kohanim obligated in Tekiat Shofar even though they are not subject to the laws of Yovel regarding land?
